parts.title: Welcome
parts.text: Camila, Ravi, and Poppy visited Grandma’s house. She waved from the **porch** and gave each child a **tender** hug. “I am so **fond** of you three,” she said. The whole house smelled like fresh bread.

parts.title: Cozy Inside
parts.text: Grandma was **doting**, and she liked to **pamper** her visitors. She sat in her **comfy** chair and began to **knit** a hat. A bright **quilt** lay over the sofa.

parts.title: Treats and Fun
parts.text: Ravi poured cold **lemonade** for everyone. Poppy told a silly joke, and Grandma gave a soft **chuckle**. Camila ate a slice of cake and tried to **savor** every bite. Later, Ravi went out to the **swing** under the old tree.

parts.title: Goodbye Hugs
parts.text: The sun began to set. The children said goodbye with big hugs. Grandma waved until the car was out of sight. They could not wait to visit again.
